data_card.units: USD adjusted price; derived returns are decimals/percent, not CPI.
data_card.availability_rule: Entire frozen snapshot must predate decision day; closing observations must also predate it. No backdated use of later adjusted history.
data_card.revision_limit: This is one forward-decision snapshot, not evidence of vintage-safe historical backtesting.
data_card.signal: 12-month VOO adjusted-price total-return proxy; if nonpositive, restrict equity weight to the entered risk-off cap. An unvalidated research hypothesis.

search_rule: Lowest historical volatility meeting the target, otherwise highest feasible return. College backing, volatility, turnover, trend and concentration checks remain binding. Search uses a10-percentage-point whole-trust grid (custom weights bypass search). Not a continuous/global optimum. Lower risk may select all SGOV; no forced equity exposure.

risk_definitions.volatility: Sample monthly return covariance, annualized by12; portfolio sqrt(wΣw). Historical estimate only.
risk_definitions.turnover: One-way target transition =0.5 sum|target-current|, plus entered year-to-date budget used. Initial funding is excluded only if explicitly selected. This is proposed-trade budget, not proof of all future annual turnover.
risk_definitions.reserve: SGOV treated as a liquid government-bill proxy solely under the confirmed modelling assumption. It is not an inflation-matched guarantee.
risk_definitions.benchmark: VOO adjusted-return proxy for S&P500 total return; ETF fees/tracking differ from the index.
risk_definitions.returns: Arithmetic annual mean for objective/search; historical constant-monthly-mix CAGR as an optional forward scenario. Not an out-of-sample strategy backtest; fund expenses are already embedded in adjusted returns.

conventions.opening_allocation: Allocate up to the full remaining college obligation from the one opening balance; the remainder is support capital.
conventions.return_and_cost_accrual: Effective annual gross returns and asset-based costs accrued between dated events using actual days / 365.2425, then rounded to cents. Both accounts share the entered annual cost rate.
conventions.cpi_scenario: Ratio starts at 1; each first-of-month reset after model start compounds one monthly step of the explicit annual CPI assumption. No published future data or reconstructed historical path is used.
conventions.payment_order: Accrue growth/costs, reset CPI, apply selected reserve transfers, pay college, then pay adult support from unreserved support assets.
conventions.rounding: Round per-child monthly benefits, semester payments, event growth and costs to cents. Twelve rounded instalments may differ from the annual amount by a few cents.
conventions.adult_recurrence: Monthly from the first payment date, anchored to its original day, clamped in shorter months; payments before model start are excluded.
conventions.terminal_payments: Include payments on the youngest-80 birthday.
conventions.adaptive_policy: Draft monthly common-share rule: reserve college first; budget discounted future minimums for all beneficiaries with the nominal planning discount capped at assumed net support growth, conservative reserve-carry drag and a cent-rounding margin and optional terminal support balance; buffer; then allocate remaining budget to a common fraction of minimum-to-goal increments. Cut immediately when required; cap monthly restoration as selected. Always pay at least the floor if cash permits; flag actual inability instead of silently waiving it. Risky returns and present-value estimates do not guarantee funding.
conventions.shortfall: Stop each path at its first unpaid scheduled distribution. Retain unpaid college due at stop. A goal-path shortfall does not by itself prove the adult minimum is unaffordable. Adaptive support is used only when explicitly enabled; partial adult payments are aggregated, not allocated among individual children.

warnings: These are explicit constant-assumption scenarios, not forecasts, probabilities, market backtests or portfolio recommendations.
The two accounts are accounting partitions, not verified eligible investments, inflation hedges or liquidity guarantees.
Taxes, contributions and changing market return paths are not modelled. Any adaptive rule is an editable draft scenario policy; initial shocks/costs are explicit inputs.
The age-80 cutoff does not terminate lifetime support or prove solvency beyond the horizon. Out-of-horizon college obligations remain reserved.
Payments missed before model start are not reconstructed. A stopped path does not assume later arrears treatment.

stress_tests.name: Persistent lower returns and higher costs

recommendation.action: Review a conditional pilot; no automatic adoption
conditions: The selected cash-flow path completed under assumptions; this is not proof of future solvency.
The pilot ceiling is a user-entered proposal, not an evaluated blend with other holdings. The return target is met by the historical estimate only.
reversal_triggers: Any college reserve backing gap or hard minimum missed payment.
Updated volatility exceeds limit, annual turnover budget exhausted, or data is quarantined/stale.
New information changes the investment thesis, costs or funding assumptions.
recommendation.committee_ask: Review candidate weights, reserve backing, draft support rule and adverse failures. Approve a limited pilot only after these assumptions are accepted; otherwise reject/revise.

limitations: Historical adjusted-price estimates are not forecasts or a vintage-safe historical strategy backtest.
SGOV is a modelling proxy, not a guarantee of CPI-linked liabilities or timely liquidation.
Turnover is the proposed transition plus entered annual usage; future trading must be separately monitored.
Shock magnitudes are editable scenarios, not event probabilities or empirical predictions. The locked student experiment is separate and remains unrun.
